root_cause_headline: Storm Drain Silt Clogging & Gravity Culvert Backflow
q1_what_is_happening: Severe localized urban waterlogging at Malad Subway (SV Road invert), with water accumulation reaching 68.0 cm and traffic speeds collapsing to 7.2 km/h.
q2_supported_explanation: Heavy monsoon runoff (82.4 mm/hr) coincided with heavy silt deposition inside the 1,200mm diameter box drain culvert, reducing gravity outflow capacity by ~72% and inducing backflow into the Malad subway invert.

BMC_AWS_02 Doppler Radar: Rainfall Telemetry (82.4 mm/hr)
